reviewer: Claude research agent; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the HyInv batch by a different agent from the extractor, against the extraction frozen at commit 2da41a749f4b0d2c03076edab37086d824794ea6, in two rounds: the review's own pass (review/apply-review.py) and the coordinator's rulings (review/apply-rulings.py). The batch holds 1,103 records (4 sources, 6 models, 1 method, 23 configurations, 1 benchmark, 8 datasets, 3 dataset subsets, 19 protocols, 485 evaluations, 498 results, 55 claims), and it adds four concepts to data/vocab/metric.ttl, one of whose definitions the second round generalised. All four pinned artifacts were re-downloaded at commit 0dcc533cc9f8f76c90ecbfe944df816b6672328a and their SHA-256 matched their source records; pdftotext -layout reproduced the archived text layer byte for byte (52ae9552b72266481b8c7190796f0bf2c93e4f8e84453c76b749b702edc50f52). npm run batch -- check-values was run over the whole batch against that text layer: of the 189 locators it can parse, 34 are in_cell and 155 in_row, with no not_in_row, wrong_column or overclaimed_in_row; its locator pattern matches only a table row, so the 309 figure and prose locators come back unparsed and were checked separately. The 170 cells of Tables 6, 7, 8 and 9 and the 290 cells of the Figure 14 and Figure 15 numeric matrices were re-read by two reviewer scripts written for this pass (review/check-tables.py, review/check-figures.py), which find each row by its printed label and split the printed cells by position without using the extractor's parser: every printed value, numeric value and column matched, and the only printed cells of those tables and figures the batch does not record are the 60 Figure 14 scTM cells that duplicate Table 6 at lower precision, the 10 dashes of the Native row and the 4 verdict cells of Table 9. Column assignment in Figure 14 was confirmed against the labelled columns of Table 2 and against Section 5.2's prose figures; Figure 15's was settled by the coordinator from the rendered page (pdftoppm -f 17 -l 17 -r 150 -png on the refetched PDF, same SHA-256): all three blocks carry the same five columns in the same order as Figure 14, and the 15 HyInv cells match the render including column assignment. Reading a rotated header is reading a label, not a value, so every recorded value still comes from the text layer. Table 1, the 8 Figure 4a bar labels and the 11 prose values were read by hand. Every locator's page number was checked against the form feeds of the text layer rather than against the parser that derived them: all 498 name the page their anchor sits on and all give the page count as 21. Two manual samples, 45 results in all, each read by eye with its row and column: 25 drawn from the 498 with random.sample and seed 20261106 over the IDs in sorted order (12 Figure 15, 4 Figure 14, 4 Table 6, 3 Table 1, 1 Figure 4a, 1 Section 6), and 20 drawn with seed 20261107 from the 309 results whose locators check-values cannot parse (14 Figure 15, 5 Figure 14, 1 Section 5.4). All 45 matched, column assignment included. Every missing_metadata entry and the absence of uncertainty on 410 results were checked against the source; no record carries a null. A third pass then applied the coordinator's follow-up through npm run records -- change against this review: facets.method_types on the 23 configurations (13 HyInv as specialist and supervised_machine_learning, 5 baselines as specialist, 5 left unset with the reason in provenance_note), the conditions around Table 5 named in full on its rule claim, and the withdrawal of the sequence-diversity change, restoring the concept definition and the 55 result qualifiers to the extraction. 80 records changed and carry a changed_by entry naming this review. A fourth pass replaced foundation_model_eligible: false with an unreported missing reason on those five configurations, recorded with npm run records -- change against this review.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude research agent, independent of the extractor but not human scientific review. Transcription was checked against the pinned source; nothing was reproduced and no value was recomputed.

npm run batch -- check-values cannot parse a figure or prose locator, so 309 of the 498 results rest on the reviewer's own parse of the text layer and on the manual samples, not on the repository's checker. A pass from that checker is also not by itself evidence: four Table 1 latency cells passed only because Figure 4a's bar labels, which print the same numbers with their units, sit inside the checker's match window.

Appendix H says every number in the report is generated by scripts from result files, but neither the scripts nor the result files are published, so no cell can be recomputed from the released artifacts.
The report PDF is not archived in the batch. Its gzipped pdftotext -layout text layer is, and the PDF can be refetched at the pinned commit and checked against artifact_sha256.

A knowledge-graph build with the batch in the store found 126 live discrepancies and no finding naming a result of this batch; the three scoped evidence concerns withhold all 498 results from comparison and from discrepancy inference, so the batch's values are recorded and marked rather than compared.

method_types on five baseline configurations is unset because the report gives their decoding strategy and weights but never their architecture class; on the coordinator's ruling those five also carry an unreported missing reason for foundation_model_eligible rather than false, since a boolean false there would assert the classification method_types leaves unset.
